subject.title: [Feature]: Redesign the iOS share extension compose sheet

question: Should the M4-stable iOS share extension adopt the full proposed branded compose-card experience, and may it add narrowly scoped brand resources to the extension target?
rationale: The UX gap is source-confirmed and roadmap-aligned, but this is protected product-design work on a stable, high-frequency native surface rather than a predefined bug fix.

options.title: Approve focused full redesign
options.body: Implement the proposed hierarchy, image previews, prominent action, and inline recovery in UIKit with only extension-safe brand resources.

options.title: Approve incremental usability fixes
options.body: Add attachment visibility and inline status or retry feedback while retaining the current overall layout and resource boundary.

options.title: Defer pending shared design seam
options.body: Keep the current compose sheet until the iOS app defines an intentional design-resource interface for extensions.

recommendation.title: Approve focused full redesign
recommendation.body: Implement the proposed hierarchy, image previews, prominent action, and inline recovery in UIKit with only extension-safe brand resources.

likelyOwner.reason: He supplied recent real-flow evidence, merged the latest share-extension work, and is best positioned to choose the scope signaled by the protected label.
